The '''Changa system''' was located in the [[Tolonda sector/Legends|Tolonda sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Unarmed combat/Legends|martial arts]] discipline known as [[Changa bushfighting]].<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Changa bushfighting]]|system=Changa [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Changa [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-18.<ref name="EAOC" /> The system shares its name with the "Changa Bloodrot," a disease mentioned in the [[1995]] outline by [[Wikipedia:Robert J. Sawyer|Robert J. Sawyer]] for the unpublished ''[[Star Wars]]'' novel ''[[Alien Exodus]]''.<ref name="Alien Exodus">{{WebCite|url=https://www.sfwriter.com/alienout.htm|text=Alien Exodus Outline|author=Wikipedia:Robert J. Sawyer|archivedate=20190725115759}}</ref>
